03Review → approval → scheduled

Team & Access

Manage who can use DBO, their role, and their phone number for WhatsApp task alerts.

Roles:
Super Admin Full control: manage users & permissions, edit or delete anything, export/import/reset the database.
Manager Everything a normal user can do, plus approve, reject or request changes on content.
Normal User Create and edit content, tasks, scripts, etc. Cannot approve content.
